storyCards.fact:
Dan Fogelberg's "Longer" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Longer" is a song written and recorded by the American singer-songwriter Dan Fogelberg and released in 1979 by Full Moon Records and Epic Records.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Longer was released in 1979.
